text:
Zoe (Account Director): Heads-up 1 Orion Logistics flagged a major billing mismatch during their Q2 true-up. They claim we double-billed embeddings across two project IDs after a migration. Their request: a retroactive credit of $45,120 and conversion of $30k of that into a 6-month amortized rebate to preserve the relationship. cc @Ken @Priya @Marco

Ken (Finance): Oof. Need the billing audit and the exact invoices affected. Also: if we do a retro credit that big, we need to consider revenue restatement vs contra-revenue treatment and IFRS/GAAP impact. Please paste invoice list and dates.

Zoe (Account Director): Affected invoices: INV-2026-701 ($18,240, 2026-04-15), INV-2026-712 ($12,880, 2026-05-09), INV-2026-733 ($14,000, 2026-06-03). Total $45,120. Customer proposes: issue $30k as a 6-mo rebate ($5k/mo) and the remaining $15,120 as an immediate credit memo. They want the credits applied to upcoming invoices and a commitment to a 12-month Enterprise contract.

Priya (Tax): If credits cross fiscal periods or involve VAT reclaims we need support docs. Are these EU invoices? If VAT was charged we may need to issue corrected invoices (credit notes) and coordinate with tax reclaim process. Also check FX exposure if original invoices were not USD.

Marco (RevOps): From ops: tag all three invoices, put account on manual billing, and block auto-churn workflows. Need a CRM note that the rebate is contingent on signed 12-month agreement within 14 days. Also recommend we cap finance exposure to $28,000 and require signed contract before issuing any rebate portion.

Leah (Legal): We'll need an amendment with credit schedule, termination/clawback language, and explicit statement the credit fully resolves the identified billing errors. Also suggest a warranty from Redwood that similar migrations are audited and fixed. Route to legal@redwood for countersign once customer signs.

Ken (Finance): Finance POV: approve up to $28,000 total (not $45,120) conditional on: 1) completed internal billing audit confirming our error, 2) signed 12-month commitment addendum uploaded to contract repo, 3) $30k rebate only issued after contract execution and amortized over 6 invoices, 4) remaining approved immediate credit capped at $8,000, posted to GL "enterprise_adjustments_q2", and 5) Tax confirms invoicing treatment. If audit shows customer error, reject.

Zoe (Account Director): Customer insists error is on our side and will sign the 12-mo if we accept $30k rebate. Theyre pushing legal to finalize quickly. I'll push for the signed addendum today.

Priya (Tax): Confirming: if any invoices have EU VAT we must issue credit notes rather than simple CRM credits and coordinate with the customer's VAT reclaim submission. Also need FX translation details for the credit amounts if invoices were EUR/GBP. Please attach the invoice PDFs.

Marco (RevOps): I'll add CRM flags and set an automated check to confirm contract upload by day 7 and day 14. Also I will prevent billing from auto-applying any credits until we get the signed amendment and tax ok.

Leah (Legal): Drafting amendment now. Recommend clause: credit becomes payable only after signed contract and we reserve right to recoup if later found to be customer-caused. Also include exact credit note language for tax purposes. Will send draft PDF to legal@redwood in ~4 hours.

billing-bot: Draft credit memo created: CM-2026-5012 (requested amount: $28,000) status: pending finance audit and legal countersign.

Ken (Finance): Final: conditional approval up to $28k as outlined. Billing, do NOT issue any credits or credit notes until finance completes the audit and tax/legal sign-off. Tag GL as "enterprise_adjustments_q2" when approved.

Zoe (Account Director): Thanks. I'll upload invoice PDFs and chase the customer for signature. Will update thread when audit result posted. :thumbsup:
